questions.prompt: Two Linux containers in the same ACI container group need to communicate on an internal-only port. Which address can they use?

options.explanation: Containers in a group share a local network.
A public frontend is unnecessary for same-group communication.

options.text: Only a separate VNet peering for each container
options.explanation: Containers in one group do not each require a peered VNet.

options.text: The ACR repository URL as the runtime service address
options.explanation: A registry stores images; it is not the running service endpoint.

questions.prompt: An ACI batch task should retry after a nonzero process exit and remain terminated after successful completion. Which restart policy explicitly expresses that behavior?

options.explanation: This policy restarts failed processes but does not restart successful completion.
Always also restarts the container after successful completion.

options.text: Never as a guarantee of exactly-once execution
options.explanation: Current documentation warns that nonzero exits can still be restarted; it is not an exactly-once guarantee.
Replica scaling is not an ACI restart-policy value.

questions.prompt: Output from an ACI task must survive deletion of its container group. Which design meets the requirement?

options.text: Write results to durable external storage and retain that storage.
options.explanation: Data durability must extend beyond the container-group lifecycle.

options.text: Store the only copy in the container writable layer.
options.explanation: Deleting and recreating the group does not preserve that layer as a durable archive.

options.text: Use Always restart policy instead of persistent storage.
options.explanation: Restart policy does not provide durable output after deletion.

options.text: Give the group a DNS label and store output only locally.
options.explanation: A DNS label does not persist container filesystem contents.
